summary: Recent updates to the Canvas area of Firefox have focused on optimizing the handling of graphics drawn in the browser. In particular, changes were made to the ANGLE project (which translates OpenGL ES calls to Direct3D or other APIs), migrating to new limits for private variable sizes. This is essential as it ensures better performance and resource management when rendering complex graphics. Additionally, some outdated configurations were removed, streamlining the codebase for improved stability and efficiency. While these changes may not create any noticeable differences for users, they contribute to a smoother overall experience when using graphics-intensive web applications.
